purpose: Track exhaustive coverage across the entire wiki. A domain is not considered complete merely because a landing page exists; records, relationships, acquisition data, verification and source provenance must also be covered.
quality_gates: Every expected record has a stable identifier or canonical name
Every record has at least one source
Indexed facts are distinguished from verified facts
Cross-system relationships are represented where applicable
Source conflicts are recorded rather than silently resolved
Automated duplicate and missing-field checks pass
